    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Ubuntu系统搭建企业级GitLab高可用主备代码仓库完整指南</span>
    

</a>

            <div class="clear"></div>

                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h2><span>一、架构选型与规划</span></h2>
<h3><span>1.1 高可用主备架构方案</span></h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>企业级GitLab高可用部署主要有以下几种主流方案：</span></p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">方案一：DRBD + Pacemaker + Corosync（主备模式）</p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>该架构为Active/Passive（主/备）模式，只有主节点运行GitLab服务并挂载存储，备节点通过DRBD实时同步数据<span>。当主节点宕机时，Pacemaker自动将VIP和存储切换到备节点。此方案适合中小型企业，硬件成本低，约比单节点增加40%<span>。</span></span></span></p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">方案二：GitLab Geo（地理分布式）</p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>GitLab企业版（EE）原生提供的Geo功能，可实现完整的实例级复制<span>。主站点可读写，辅助站点只读，支持自动故障转移<span>。需要GitLab Premium或Ultimate订阅<span>。</span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">方案三：分层高可用架构（官方参考架构）</p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>将GitLab各组件拆分部署：前端负载均衡（HAProxy/Nginx）+ 多个GitLab应用节点 + PostgreSQL集群（Patroni+etcd）+ Redis Sentinel + 共享存储（NFS/Ceph）<span>。适合大规模企业<span>。</span></span></span></p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">本文推荐方案一（DRBD + Pacemaker）<span> ，性价比高、部署相对简单，适合大多数企业场景。如团队规模超过200人，建议升级到方案三<span>。</span></span></p>
<h3><span>1.2 硬件配置建议</span></h3>
<div class="ds-scroll-area ds-scroll-area--show-on-focus-within ds-scroll-area--enabled _1210dd7 c03cafe9">
<div class="ds-scroll-area__gutters">&nbsp;</div>
<table>
<thead>
<tr><th><span>团队规模</span></th><th><span>CPU</span></th><th><span>内存</span></th><th><span>存储</span></th><th><span>网络</span></th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><span>5-20人</span></td>
<td><span>4核</span></td>
<td><span>8GB</span></td>
<td><span>100GB SSD</span></td>
<td><span>100Mbps</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>20-100人</span></td>
<td><span>8核</span></td>
<td><span>16GB</span></td>
<td><span>500GB NVMe SSD</span></td>
<td><span>1Gbps</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>100人以上</span></td>
<td><span>16核+</span></td>
<td><span>32GB+</span></td>
<td><span>RAID10 SSD阵列</span></td>
<td><span>多网卡绑定</span></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">&nbsp;</p>
<blockquote>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>⚠️ 生产环境强烈建议使用SSD存储，GitLab官方建议禁用swap分区<span>。</span></span></p>
</blockquote>
<h3><span>1.3 服务器规划示例</span></h3>
<div class="ds-scroll-area ds-scroll-area--show-on-focus-within ds-scroll-area--enabled _1210dd7 c03cafe9">
<div class="ds-scroll-area__gutters">&nbsp;</div>
<table>

<tbody>
<tr>
<td><span>主节点</span></td>
<td><span>gitlab-primary</span></td>
<td><span>192.168.1.10</span></td>
<td><span>8核16G + 500GB SSD</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>备节点</span></td>
<td><span>gitlab-secondary</span></td>
<td><span>192.168.1.11</span></td>
<td><span>8核16G + 500GB SSD</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>虚拟IP（VIP）</span></td>
<td><span>gitlab.local</span></td>
<td><span>192.168.1.100</span></td>
<td><span>浮动IP</span></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
<h2><span>二、基础环境准备（两台节点均需执行）</span></h2>

<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token comment"># 更新系统
<span class="token function">sudo <span class="token function">apt update <span class="token operator">&amp;&amp; <span class="token function">sudo <span class="token function">apt upgrade <span class="token parameter variable">-y

<span class="token comment"># 安装必要依赖
<span class="token function">sudo <span class="token function">apt <span class="token function">install <span class="token parameter variable">-y <span class="token punctuation">\
    <span class="token function">curl <span class="token punctuation">\
    openssh-server <span class="token punctuation">\
    ca-certificates <span class="token punctuation">\
    tzdata <span class="token punctuation">\
    perl <span class="token punctuation">\
    postfix <span class="token punctuation">\
    <span class="token function">wget <span class="token punctuation">\
    gnupg <span class="token punctuation">\
    lsb-release <span class="token punctuation">\
    software-properties-common</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>安装postfix时，如选择“Internet Site”，输入你的邮件域名；如暂不需要邮件功能可跳过。</span></p>
<h3><span>2.2 配置防火墙</span></h3>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token function">sudo ufw allow <span class="token number">22/tcp      <span class="token comment"># SSH访问
<span class="token function">sudo ufw allow <span class="token number">80/tcp      <span class="token comment"># HTTP服务
<span class="token function">sudo ufw allow <span class="token number">443/tcp     <span class="token comment"># HTTPS服务
<span class="token function">sudo ufw allow <span class="token number">9090/tcp    <span class="token comment"># Prometheus监控（可选）
<span class="token function">sudo ufw <span class="token builtin class-name">enable</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">&nbsp;</p>
<h3><span>2.3 系统优化配置</span></h3>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token comment"># 禁用swap（GitLab官方建议）
<span class="token function">sudo swapoff <span class="token parameter variable">-a
<span class="token function">sudo <span class="token function">sed <span class="token parameter variable">-i <span class="token string">'/ swap / s/^\(.*\)$/#\1/g' /etc/fstab

<span class="token comment"># 配置时区
<span class="token function">sudo timedatectl set-timezone Asia/Shanghai

<span class="token comment"># 优化系统文件句柄限制
<span class="token builtin class-name">echo <span class="token string">"fs.file-max = 65536" <span class="token operator">| <span class="token function">sudo <span class="token function">tee <span class="token parameter variable">-a /etc/sysctl.conf
<span class="token function">sudo <span class="token function">sysctl <span class="token parameter variable">-p</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">&nbsp;</p>
<h3><span>2.4 配置SSH免密登录（主备节点间）</span></h3>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token comment"># 在主节点生成SSH密钥
ssh-keygen <span class="token parameter variable">-t rsa <span class="token parameter variable">-b <span class="token number">4096 <span class="token parameter variable">-N <span class="token string">"" <span class="token parameter variable">-f ~/.ssh/id_rsa

<span class="token comment"># 将公钥复制到备节点
ssh-copy-id root@192.168.1.11

<span class="token comment"># 同样在备节点生成并复制到主节点
ssh-keygen <span class="token parameter variable">-t rsa <span class="token parameter variable">-b <span class="token number">4096 <span class="token parameter variable">-N <span class="token string">"" <span class="token parameter variable">-f ~/.ssh/id_rsa
ssh-copy-id root@192.168.1.10</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<h2><span>三、安装GitLab</span></h2>
<h3><span>3.1 添加GitLab官方仓库</span></h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">使用官方源（国外服务器较快）：</p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token function">curl <span class="token parameter variable">-sS https://packages.gitlab.com/install/repositories/gitlab/gitlab-ee/script.deb.sh <span class="token operator">| <span class="token function">sudo <span class="token function">bash</span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">使用国内清华镜像源（推荐国内用户）：</p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token comment"># 信任GitLab GPG公钥
<span class="token function">curl <span class="token parameter variable">-fsSL https://packages.gitlab.com/gpg.key <span class="token operator">| <span class="token function">sudo gpg <span class="token parameter variable">--dearmor <span class="token parameter variable">-o /usr/share/keyrings/gitlab_gitlab-ee-archive-keyring.gpg

<span class="token comment"># 添加源
<span class="token builtin class-name">echo <span class="token string">"deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/gitlab_gitlab-ee-archive-keyring.gpg] https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/gitlab-ee/ubuntu <span class="token variable"><span class="token variable">$(lsb_release <span class="token parameter variable">-cs<span class="token variable">) main" <span class="token operator">| <span class="token function">sudo <span class="token function">tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/gitlab-ee.list

<span class="token function">sudo <span class="token function">apt update</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">&nbsp;</p>
<blockquote>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>💡 如使用社区版（CE），将上述命令中的<code>gitlab-ee</code><span>替换为<code>gitlab-ce</code><span>。企业版（EE）提供更多高可用特性，生产环境建议使用企业版<span>。</span></span></span></span></p>
</blockquote>
<h3><span>3.2 安装GitLab</span></h3>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token comment"># 安装企业版（设置外部访问URL）
<span class="token function">sudo <span class="token assign-left variable">EXTERNAL_URL<span class="token operator">=<span class="token string">"https://gitlab.local" <span class="token function">apt-get <span class="token function">install <span class="token parameter variable">-y gitlab-ee</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">&nbsp;</p>
<blockquote>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>如果尚未配置域名和SSL证书，可先使用IP地址：<code>EXTERNAL_URL="http://192.168.1.10"</code></span></p>
</blockquote>
<h3><span>3.3 初始配置</span></h3>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">

<span class="token function">sudo <span class="token function">vim /etc/gitlab/gitlab.rb</span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">基础配置项：</p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">ruby</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token comment"># 外部访问地址
external_url <span class="token string-literal"><span class="token string">'https://gitlab.local'

<span class="token comment"># 时区
gitlab_rails<span class="token punctuation">[<span class="token string-literal"><span class="token string">'time_zone'<span class="token punctuation">] <span class="token operator">= <span class="token string-literal"><span class="token string">'Asia/Shanghai'

<span class="token comment"># 数据存储目录（后续将迁移到共享存储）
git_data_dirs<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token punctuation">{
  <span class="token string-literal"><span class="token string">"default" <span class="token operator">=&gt; <span class="token punctuation">{
    <span class="token string-literal"><span class="token string">"path" <span class="token operator">=&gt; <span class="token string-literal"><span class="token string">"/var/opt/gitlab/git-data"
  <span class="token punctuation">}
<span class="token punctuation">}<span class="token punctuation">)

<span class="token comment"># 邮件配置（可选）
gitlab_rails<span class="token punctuation">[<span class="token string-literal"><span class="token string">'smtp_enable'<span class="token punctuation">] <span class="token operator">= <span class="token boolean">true
gitlab_rails<span class="token punctuation">[<span class="token string-literal"><span class="token string">'smtp_address'<span class="token punctuation">] <span class="token operator">= <span class="token string-literal"><span class="token string">"smtp.your-email.com"
gitlab_rails<span class="token punctuation">[<span class="token string-literal"><span class="token string">'smtp_port'<span class="token punctuation">] <span class="token operator">= <span class="token number">587
gitlab_rails<span class="token punctuation">[<span class="token string-literal"><span class="token string">'smtp_user_name'<span class="token punctuation">] <span class="token operator">= <span class="token string-literal"><span class="token string">"gitlab@your-email.com"
gitlab_rails<span class="token punctuation">[<span class="token string-literal"><span class="token string">'smtp_password'<span class="token punctuation">] <span class="token operator">= <span class="token string-literal"><span class="token string">"your-password"
gitlab_rails<span class="token punctuation">[<span class="token string-literal"><span class="token string">'smtp_domain'<span class="token punctuation">] <span class="token operator">= <span class="token string-literal"><span class="token string">"your-email.com"
gitlab_rails<span class="token punctuation">[<span class="token string-literal"><span class="token string">'smtp_authentication'<span class="token punctuation">] <span class="token operator">= <span class="token string-literal"><span class="token string">"login"
gitlab_rails<span class="token punctuation">[<span class="token string-literal"><span class="token string">'smtp_enable_starttls_auto'<span class="token punctuation">] <span class="token operator">= <span class="token boolean">true
gitlab_rails<span class="token punctuation">[<span class="token string-literal"><span class="token string">'gitlab_email_from'<span class="token punctuation">] <span class="token operator">= <span class="token string-literal"><span class="token string">'gitlab@your-email.com'</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">&nbsp;</p>

<h2><span>四、高可用核心组件配置</span></h2>
<h3><span>4.1 配置共享存储（DRBD）</span></h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>DRBD实现两台服务器间数据的实时块级同步<span>。</span></span></p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">在两台节点上安装DRBD：</p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token function">sudo <span class="token function">apt <span class="token function">install <span class="token parameter variable">-y drbd-utils</span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">在主节点创建DRBD配置文件：</p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token function">sudo <span class="token function">vim /etc/drbd.d/gitlab.res</span></span></pre>
</div>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">conf</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>resource gitlab {
    protocol C;
    meta-disk internal;

    device /dev/drbd0;
    disk /dev/sdb;  # 请替换为实际的数据盘设备

    net {
        cram-hmac-alg sha1;
        shared-secret "your-secure-secret-key";
    }

    on gitlab-primary {
        address 192.168.1.10:7789;
    }

    on gitlab-secondary {
        address 192.168.1.11:7789;
    }
}</pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">初始化DRBD资源（两台节点执行）：</p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token comment"># 创建元数据
<span class="token function">sudo drbdadm create-md gitlab

<span class="token comment"># 启动DRBD服务
<span class="token function">sudo systemctl <span class="token builtin class-name">enable drbd
<span class="token function">sudo systemctl start drbd

<span class="token comment"># 在主节点提升为Primary
<span class="token function">sudo drbdadm primary <span class="token parameter variable">--force gitlab

<span class="token comment"># 创建文件系统（仅在主节点执行）
<span class="token function">sudo mkfs.ext4 /dev/drbd0

<span class="token comment"># 挂载存储
<span class="token function">sudo <span class="token function">mkdir <span class="token parameter variable">-p /mnt/gitlab-data
<span class="token function">sudo <span class="token function">mount /dev/drbd0 /mnt/gitlab-data</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">配置自动挂载：</p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token builtin class-name">echo <span class="token string">'/dev/drbd0 /mnt/gitlab-data ext4 defaults,noatime 0 0' <span class="token operator">| <span class="token function">sudo <span class="token function">tee <span class="token parameter variable">-a /etc/fstab</span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<h3><span>4.2 配置GitLab使用共享存储</span></h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">修改GitLab数据目录：</p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">

<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token function">sudo <span class="token function">vim /etc/gitlab/gitlab.rb</span></span></pre>
</div>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">ruby</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token comment"># 将数据目录指向共享存储
git_data_dirs<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token punctuation">{
  <span class="token string-literal"><span class="token string">"default" <span class="token operator">=&gt; <span class="token punctuation">{
    <span class="token string-literal"><span class="token string">"path" <span class="token operator">=&gt; <span class="token string-literal"><span class="token string">"/mnt/gitlab-data/git-data"
  <span class="token punctuation">}
<span class="token punctuation">}<span class="token punctuation">)

<span class="token comment"># 仓库存储路径
gitlab_rails<span class="token punctuation">[<span class="token string-literal"><span class="token string">'repository_storage_dirs'<span class="token punctuation">] <span class="token operator">= <span class="token punctuation">{
  <span class="token string-literal"><span class="token string">"default" <span class="token operator">=&gt; <span class="token string-literal"><span class="token string">"/mnt/gitlab-data/git-data/repositories"
<span class="token punctuation">}

<span class="token comment"># 上传文件存储
gitlab_rails<span class="token punctuation">[<span class="token string-literal"><span class="token string">'uploads_directory'<span class="token punctuation">] <span class="token operator">= <span class="token string-literal"><span class="token string">"/mnt/gitlab-data/uploads"</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">迁移现有数据到共享存储（如已存在数据）：</p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">

<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token comment"># 停止GitLab服务
<span class="token function">sudo gitlab-ctl stop

<span class="token comment"># 迁移数据
<span class="token function">sudo <span class="token function">rsync <span class="token parameter variable">-av /var/opt/gitlab/ /mnt/gitlab-data/

<span class="token comment"># 重新配置并启动
<span class="token function">sudo gitlab-ctl reconfigure
<span class="token function">sudo gitlab-ctl start</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>

<h3><span>4.3 配置PostgreSQL高可用（Patroni + etcd）</span></h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>GitLab官方推荐使用Patroni + etcd实现PostgreSQL自动主备切换<span>。</span></span></p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">在两台节点安装etcd和Patroni：</p>

</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">配置etcd集群（两台节点）：</p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">

<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>主节点配置：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">

<pre>ETCD_NAME="etcd1"
ETCD_INITIAL_ADVERTISE_PEER_URLS="http://192.168.1.10:2380"
ETCD_LISTEN_PEER_URLS="http://0.0.0.0:2380"
ETCD_LISTEN_CLIENT_URLS="http://0.0.0.0:2379"
ETCD_ADVERTISE_CLIENT_URLS="http://192.168.1.10:2379"
ETCD_INITIAL_CLUSTER="etcd1=http://192.168.1.10:2380,etcd2=http://192.168.1.11:2380"
ETCD_INITIAL_CLUSTER_STATE="new"</pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>备节点将IP替换为<code>192.168.1.11</code><span>，ETCD_NAME改为<code>etcd2</code><span>。</span></span></span></p>

<span class="token key atrule">bootstrap<span class="token punctuation">:
  <span class="token key atrule">dcs<span class="token punctuation">:
    <span class="token key atrule">ttl<span class="token punctuation">: <span class="token number">30
    <span class="token key atrule">loop_wait<span class="token punctuation">: <span class="token number">10
    <span class="token key atrule">retry_timeout<span class="token punctuation">: <span class="token number">10
    <span class="token key atrule">maximum_lag_on_failover<span class="token punctuation">: <span class="token number">1048576
    <span class="token key atrule">postgresql<span class="token punctuation">:
      <span class="token key atrule">use_pg_rewind<span class="token punctuation">: <span class="token boolean important">true
      <span class="token key atrule">parameters<span class="token punctuation">:
        <span class="token key atrule">max_connections<span class="token punctuation">: <span class="token number">200
        <span class="token key atrule">shared_buffers<span class="token punctuation">: 256MB
        <span class="token key atrule">wal_level<span class="token punctuation">: replica
        <span class="token key atrule">hot_standby<span class="token punctuation">: <span class="token string">"on"
        <span class="token key atrule">max_wal_senders<span class="token punctuation">: <span class="token number">10

<span class="token key atrule">postgresql<span class="token punctuation">:
  <span class="token key atrule">listen<span class="token punctuation">: 0.0.0.0<span class="token punctuation">:<span class="token number">5432
  <span class="token key atrule">connect_address<span class="token punctuation">: 192.168.1.10<span class="token punctuation">:<span class="token number">5432  <span class="token comment"># 备节点改为备节点IP
  <span class="token key atrule">data_dir<span class="token punctuation">: /mnt/gitlab<span class="token punctuation">-data/postgresql
  <span class="token key atrule">pgpass<span class="token punctuation">: /tmp/pgpass
  <span class="token key atrule">authentication<span class="token punctuation">:

<h3><span>4.4 配置Redis高可用（Redis Sentinel）</span></h3>

<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">

<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token function">sudo <span class="token function">apt <span class="token function">install <span class="token parameter variable">-y redis-server</span></span></span></span></pre>

<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">配置Redis主从：</p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>主节点 <code>/etc/redis/redis.conf</code><span>：</span></span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">conf</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>bind 0.0.0.0
port 6379
requirepass your-redis-password
masterauth your-redis-password</pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>备节点 <code>/etc/redis/redis.conf</code><span>：</span></span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">

</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>bind 0.0.0.0
port 6379
requirepass your-redis-password
masterauth your-redis-password
replicaof 192.168.1.10 6379</pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">配置Redis Sentinel（两台节点）：</p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">

<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>

<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">conf</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>bind 0.0.0.0
port 26379
sentinel monitor gitlab-redis 192.168.1.10 6379 2
sentinel auth-pass gitlab-redis your-redis-password
sentinel down-after-milliseconds gitlab-redis 5000
sentinel failover-timeout gitlab-redis 60000</pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">启动服务：</p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token function">sudo systemctl <span class="token builtin class-name">enable redis-server redis-sentinel
<span class="token function">sudo systemctl start redis-server redis-sentinel</span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">配置GitLab使用Redis Sentinel：</p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">

</div>

</div>
<pre><span class="token comment"># /etc/gitlab/gitlab.rb
redis<span class="token punctuation">[<span class="token string-literal"><span class="token string">'enable'<span class="token punctuation">] <span class="token operator">= <span class="token boolean">false
gitlab_rails<span class="token punctuation">[<span class="token string-literal"><span class="token string">'redis_host'<span class="token punctuation">] <span class="token operator">= <span class="token string-literal"><span class="token string">'192.168.1.10'

gitlab_rails<span class="token punctuation">[<span class="token string-literal"><span class="token string">'redis_password'<span class="token punctuation">] <span class="token operator">= <span class="token string-literal"><span class="token string">'your-redis-password'</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>

<h3><span>4.5 配置负载均衡与VIP漂移（Keepalived）</span></h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">安装Keepalived（两台节点）：</p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token function">sudo <span class="token function">apt <span class="token function">install <span class="token parameter variable">-y keepalived</span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>主节点配置 <code>/etc/keepalived/keepalived.conf</code><span>：</span></span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">conf</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>vrrp_instance VI_1 {
    state MASTER
    interface eth0
    virtual_router_id 51
    priority 100
    advert_int 1
    authentication {
        auth_type PASS
        auth_pass your-auth-password
    }
    virtual_ipaddress {
        192.168.1.100/24 dev eth0
    }
    track_script {
        check_gitlab
    }
}

vrrp_script check_gitlab {
    script "/usr/local/bin/check_gitlab.sh"
    interval 5
    weight -10
}</pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">备节点配置<span>（state改为BACKUP，priority改为90）。</span></p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>健康检查脚本 <code>/usr/local/bin/check_gitlab.sh</code><span>：</span></span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token shebang important">#!/bin/bash
<span class="token keyword">if <span class="token function">curl <span class="token parameter variable">-s <span class="token parameter variable">-o /dev/null <span class="token parameter variable">-w <span class="token string">"%{http_code}" http://localhost:80/ <span class="token operator">| <span class="token function">grep <span class="token parameter variable">-q <span class="token string">"200\|302"<span class="token punctuation">; <span class="token keyword">then
    <span class="token builtin class-name">exit <span class="token number">0
<span class="token keyword">else
    <span class="token builtin class-name">exit <span class="token number">1
<span class="token keyword">fi</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token function">sudo <span class="token function">chmod +x /usr/local/bin/check_gitlab.sh
<span class="token function">sudo systemctl <span class="token builtin class-name">enable keepalived
<span class="token function">sudo systemctl start keepalived</span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">&nbsp;</p>
<h3><span>4.6 配置Nginx负载均衡（可选）</span></h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>如需在前端增加负载均衡层<span>：</span></span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token function">sudo <span class="token function">apt <span class="token function">install <span class="token parameter variable">-y nginx</span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">nginx</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token comment"># /etc/nginx/sites-available/gitlab
<span class="token directive"><span class="token keyword">upstream gitlab_backend <span class="token punctuation">{
    <span class="token directive"><span class="token keyword">server 192.168.1.10:80 max_fails=3 fail_timeout=30s<span class="token punctuation">;
    <span class="token directive"><span class="token keyword">server 192.168.1.11:80 max_fails=3 fail_timeout=30s backup<span class="token punctuation">;
    <span class="token directive"><span class="token keyword">keepalive <span class="token number">32<span class="token punctuation">;
<span class="token punctuation">}

<span class="token directive"><span class="token keyword">server <span class="token punctuation">{
    <span class="token directive"><span class="token keyword">listen <span class="token number">80<span class="token punctuation">;
    <span class="token directive"><span class="token keyword">server_name gitlab.local<span class="token punctuation">;
    
    <span class="token directive"><span class="token keyword">location / <span class="token punctuation">{
        <span class="token directive"><span class="token keyword">proxy_pass http://gitlab_backend<span class="token punctuation">;
        <span class="token directive"><span class="token keyword">proxy_set_header Host <span class="token variable">$host<span class="token punctuation">;
        <span class="token directive"><span class="token keyword">proxy_set_header X-Real-IP <span class="token variable">$remote_addr<span class="token punctuation">;
        <span class="token directive"><span class="token keyword">proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For <span class="token variable">$proxy_add_x_forwarded_for<span class="token punctuation">;
        <span class="token directive"><span class="token keyword">proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto <span class="token variable">$scheme<span class="token punctuation">;
        <span class="token directive"><span class="token keyword">proxy_http_version 1.1<span class="token punctuation">;
        <span class="token directive"><span class="token keyword">proxy_set_header Connection <span class="token string">""<span class="token punctuation">;
    <span class="token punctuation">}
<span class="token punctuation">}</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">&nbsp;</p>
<h2><span>五、配置SSL证书（HTTPS）</span></h2>
<h3><span>5.1 使用Let's Encrypt免费证书</span></h3>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token function">sudo <span class="token function">apt <span class="token function">install <span class="token parameter variable">-y certbot python3-certbot-nginx

<span class="token comment"># 申请证书（需已配置域名解析）
<span class="token function">sudo certbot certonly <span class="token parameter variable">--nginx <span class="token parameter variable">-d gitlab.yourdomain.com

<span class="token comment"># 自动续期
<span class="token builtin class-name">echo <span class="token string">"0 3 * * * root /usr/bin/certbot renew --quiet" <span class="token operator">| <span class="token function">sudo <span class="token function">tee /etc/cron.d/certbot-renew</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">&nbsp;</p>
<h3><span>5.2 配置GitLab使用SSL</span></h3>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">ruby</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token comment"># /etc/gitlab/gitlab.rb
external_url <span class="token string-literal"><span class="token string">'https://gitlab.yourdomain.com'

nginx<span class="token punctuation">[<span class="token string-literal"><span class="token string">'redirect_http_to_https'<span class="token punctuation">] <span class="token operator">= <span class="token boolean">true
nginx<span class="token punctuation">[<span class="token string-literal"><span class="token string">'ssl_certificate'<span class="token punctuation">] <span class="token operator">= <span class="token string-literal"><span class="token string">"/etc/letsencrypt/live/gitlab.yourdomain.com/fullchain.pem"
nginx<span class="token punctuation">[<span class="token string-literal"><span class="token string">'ssl_certificate_key'<span class="token punctuation">] <span class="token operator">= <span class="token string-literal"><span class="token string">"/etc/letsencrypt/live/gitlab.yourdomain.com/privkey.pem"
nginx<span class="token punctuation">[<span class="token string-literal"><span class="token string">'ssl_protocols'<span class="token punctuation">] <span class="token operator">= <span class="token string-literal"><span class="token string">"TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3"</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">&nbsp;</p>
<h2><span>六、监控与告警配置</span></h2>
<h3><span>6.1 启用GitLab内置监控</span></h3>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">ruby</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token comment"># /etc/gitlab/gitlab.rb
prometheus<span class="token punctuation">[<span class="token string-literal"><span class="token string">'enable'<span class="token punctuation">] <span class="token operator">= <span class="token boolean">true
prometheus<span class="token punctuation">[<span class="token string-literal"><span class="token string">'listen_address'<span class="token punctuation">] <span class="token operator">= <span class="token string-literal"><span class="token string">'0.0.0.0:9090'

node_exporter<span class="token punctuation">[<span class="token string-literal"><span class="token string">'enable'<span class="token punctuation">] <span class="token operator">= <span class="token boolean">true
node_exporter<span class="token punctuation">[<span class="token string-literal"><span class="token string">'listen_address'<span class="token punctuation">] <span class="token operator">= <span class="token string-literal"><span class="token string">'0.0.0.0:9100'

redis_exporter<span class="token punctuation">[<span class="token string-literal"><span class="token string">'enable'<span class="token punctuation">] <span class="token operator">= <span class="token boolean">true
redis_exporter<span class="token punctuation">[<span class="token string-literal"><span class="token string">'listen_address'<span class="token punctuation">] <span class="token operator">= <span class="token string-literal"><span class="token string">'0.0.0.0:9121'

postgres_exporter<span class="token punctuation">[<span class="token string-literal"><span class="token string">'enable'<span class="token punctuation">] <span class="token operator">= <span class="token boolean">true
postgres_exporter<span class="token punctuation">[<span class="token string-literal"><span class="token string">'listen_address'<span class="token punctuation">] <span class="token operator">= <span class="token string-literal"><span class="token string">'0.0.0.0:9187'

gitlab_exporter<span class="token punctuation">[<span class="token string-literal"><span class="token string">'enable'<span class="token punctuation">] <span class="token operator">= <span class="token boolean">true
gitlab_exporter<span class="token punctuation">[<span class="token string-literal"><span class="token string">'listen_address'<span class="token punctuation">] <span class="token operator">= <span class="token string-literal"><span class="token string">'0.0.0.0:9168'</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">&nbsp;</p>
<h3><span>6.2 安装Grafana可视化</span></h3>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token function">sudo <span class="token function">apt <span class="token function">install <span class="token parameter variable">-y grafana
<span class="token function">sudo systemctl <span class="token builtin class-name">enable grafana-server
<span class="token function">sudo systemctl start grafana-server</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>访问 <code>http://gitlab.local:3000</code><span>，添加Prometheus数据源，导入GitLab官方仪表盘<span>。</span></span></span></p>
<h3><span>6.3 关键告警阈值</span></h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>建议设置以下告警<span>：</span></span></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>PostgreSQL连接数 &gt; 最大值的80%</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>Redis内存使用 &gt; 8GB</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>仓库存储空间 &gt; 90%</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>Sidekiq队列积压 &gt; 1000</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>HTTP 500错误率 &gt; 1%</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<h2><span>七、备份策略</span></h2>
<h3><span>7.1 定期备份</span></h3>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token comment"># 创建完整备份
<span class="token function">sudo gitlab-rake gitlab:backup:create

<span class="token comment"># 备份配置文件
<span class="token function">sudo <span class="token function">tar <span class="token parameter variable">-czf /mnt/gitlab-data/backups/gitlab-config-<span class="token variable"><span class="token variable">$(<span class="token function">date +%Y%m%d<span class="token variable">).tar.gz /etc/gitlab/</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">&nbsp;</p>
<h3><span>7.2 自动化备份脚本</span></h3>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token shebang important">#!/bin/bash
<span class="token comment"># /usr/local/bin/gitlab-backup.sh

<span class="token assign-left variable">BACKUP_DIR<span class="token operator">=<span class="token string">"/mnt/gitlab-data/backups"
<span class="token assign-left variable">DATE<span class="token operator">=<span class="token variable"><span class="token variable">$(<span class="token function">date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S<span class="token variable">)

<span class="token comment"># 创建备份
<span class="token function">sudo gitlab-rake gitlab:backup:create

<span class="token comment"># 备份配置文件
<span class="token function">sudo <span class="token function">tar <span class="token parameter variable">-czf <span class="token variable">${BACKUP_DIR}/gitlab-config-<span class="token variable">${DATE}.tar.gz /etc/gitlab/

<span class="token comment"># 保留最近7天的备份
<span class="token function">find <span class="token variable">${BACKUP_DIR} <span class="token parameter variable">-name <span class="token string">"*.tar" <span class="token parameter variable">-mtime +7 <span class="token parameter variable">-delete
<span class="token function">find <span class="token variable">${BACKUP_DIR} <span class="token parameter variable">-name <span class="token string">"*.tar.gz" <span class="token parameter variable">-mtime +7 <span class="token parameter variable">-delete</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token comment"># 添加到crontab（每天凌晨2点执行）
<span class="token builtin class-name">echo <span class="token string">"0 2 * * * /usr/local/bin/gitlab-backup.sh" <span class="token operator">| <span class="token function">sudo <span class="token function">tee <span class="token parameter variable">-a /etc/crontab</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<h2><span>八、故障转移与恢复</span></h2>
<h3><span>8.1 手动故障转移（主节点故障时）</span></h3>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token comment"># 在备节点上
<span class="token comment"># 1. 提升DRBD为Primary
<span class="token function">sudo drbdadm primary gitlab

<span class="token comment"># 2. 挂载存储
<span class="token function">sudo <span class="token function">mount /dev/drbd0 /mnt/gitlab-data

<span class="token comment"># 3. 启动GitLab
<span class="token function">sudo gitlab-ctl start

<span class="token comment"># 4. 提升Keepalived为MASTER（或等待自动切换）
<span class="token function">sudo systemctl restart keepalived</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<h3><span>8.2 自动故障转移</span></h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>通过Keepalived + DRBD + Pacemaker组合可实现自动故障转移<span>。配置Pacemaker资源管理：</span></span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token function">sudo <span class="token function">apt <span class="token function">install <span class="token parameter variable">-y pacemaker corosync

<span class="token comment"># 配置Corosync集群
<span class="token function">sudo <span class="token function">vim /etc/corosync/corosync.conf

<span class="token comment"># 添加资源：VIP、DRBD、GitLab服务
<span class="token function">sudo pcs resource create gitlab-vip IPaddr2 <span class="token assign-left variable">ip<span class="token operator">=<span class="token number">192.168.1.100
<span class="token function">sudo pcs resource create gitlab-drbd drbd <span class="token punctuation">...
<span class="token function">sudo pcs resource create gitlab-service systemd:gitlab-runsvdir</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<h2><span>九、运维管理要点</span></h2>
<h3><span>9.1 日常巡检命令</span></h3>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token comment"># 查看GitLab服务状态
<span class="token function">sudo gitlab-ctl status

<span class="token comment"># 查看日志
<span class="token function">sudo gitlab-ctl <span class="token function">tail

<span class="token comment"># 查看DRBD同步状态
<span class="token function">sudo drbdadm status gitlab

<span class="token comment"># 查看集群状态
<span class="token function">sudo pcs status

<span class="token comment"># 查看Keepalived状态
<span class="token function">sudo systemctl status keepalived</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<h3><span>9.2 版本升级</span></h3>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token comment"># 停止GitLab（生产环境建议在维护窗口进行）
<span class="token function">sudo gitlab-ctl stop unicorn
<span class="token function">sudo gitlab-ctl stop sidekiq

<span class="token comment"># 更新包
<span class="token function">sudo <span class="token function">apt update
<span class="token function">sudo <span class="token function">apt <span class="token function">install --only-upgrade gitlab-ee

<span class="token comment"># 重新配置
<span class="token function">sudo gitlab-ctl reconfigure
<span class="token function">sudo gitlab-ctl restart</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<h3><span>9.3 安全加固建议</span></h3>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>启用2FA双因素认证</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>配置IP白名单限制管理访问</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>禁用默认root账户登录</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>定期更新系统与GitLab版本</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>启用审计日志</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
